invite.subject: Set your ShuleOS password before you lose the invite
invite.body: Your school{schoolClause} has added you to ShuleOS. Until you set a short password (4 digits or 4 letters), you cannot sign in — and your role stays locked out of the system.
invite.expiry: This link expires. If it does, ask your admin to send a new invite and use the latest email.
invite.text:
Hi {name},

Your school{schoolClause} has added you to ShuleOS. Until you set a password, you cannot sign in — and your role stays locked out of the system.

Set your password: {url}

This link expires. If it does, ask your admin to send a new invite.

admissionApproved.subject: Admission approved - {studentName}
admissionApproved.body: {studentName}'s admission application at {schoolName} has been approved.
admissionApproved.next: If you have an account, sign in to complete the next steps. If you need help, reply to this email or contact the school office.
